topic: Account mein achanak anjaan paisa aaya? Wapas mat bhejna, ye naya scam hai
hook: Account mein anjaan paisa aaya? Ruko. Wapas mat bhejna.
why: scam alert + fear + one clear action; strongest small-channel breakout in the niche
evidence: Finance Wali Dost YT Short 388,508 views in 30 days with 986 subscribers; NPCI + Google anti-fraud news 13 Nov
source: Sanchar Saathi (DoT) 'Jump Deposit Fraud' advisory; SBI warning 10 Oct 2026 (Mint): a stranger sends a small amount, then calls saying it was a mistake and pushes you to return it, often via a collect request where you enter your UPI PIN, or with a fake payment screenshot. Safe: check the real balance in your bank app (not a screenshot); you NEVER enter a UPI PIN to receive money; do not return it yourself, tell them to ask their own bank to reverse it; report on 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in and Chakshu on Sanchar Saathi. No loss figures.
